wordingCorrection: Wall of Ice has flavor only. Exact printing reviewed, empty rules supplied explicitly; Oracle Defender remains separate. No broad empty-text inference from a missing provider field.
scope: All 302 original printings use the installed shared Unlimited profile. Native replay verifies 302 corrected Originals, 604 Oracle faces and 302 historical controls with no missing assets or overflow. Thirteen physical artist corrections are independent of wording mode. All scan poses are frozen, all regressions remain, and full-set visual normalization review is recorded. Publication and its matching checklist receipt remain pending. Regional study descriptions below retain their historical scope; final evidence supersedes their adoption/replay requirements.

native.purpose: Baseline only; this is not a complete-set layout certification.

releaseBaseline.purpose: Native baseline, not a completed set calibration.

outerBoundaryDiagnostic.decision: The printed outer frame is consistently undersized, about two canonical pixels in width and height. Retain the independent scan poses. Trial frame/mask geometry and compare internal apertures before adjusting colors; do not hide renderer geometry errors with a new scan transform. Art/rules bevels and frame-family selection remain open.
outerBoundaryDiagnostic.proposal: Seven shared material transforms are predicted from the preselected calibration cohorts. Reserved-scan median residuals are 0.05-0.09 canonical px. These are boundary-model predictions, not replayed renderer scores. Native candidate and internal-aperture checks are required before adoption.

frameSourceReview.summary: ABU retained for six main materials after fitting every family to calibration-only art/paper boundaries. ABU has the best or nearly tied calibration mean; green is within 0.002 of Fourth. No alternate source has a decisive gain. Basic lands remain separately provisional; dual-overlay source/geometry is still open. Native source/geometry/color promotion is not implied by this diagnostic.

stockMaskTrial.scope: Existing source frame/art/lettering remain unchanged. All 302 independent poses are frozen. Default etching outputs match; this does not certify nondefault etching inputs.

jointGeometryTrial.scope: Regional frame-strip index only, not a whole-card Lab score. Two-axis frame transforms fit predeclared calibration cohorts only. All baseline faces match immutable native PNG bytes. Original scan poses remain fixed. Native inputs predate the new Dragon Whelp paragraph correction; these frame-only targets exclude its lettering.
jointGeometryTrial.remaining: The initial white regression was followed by seven shared candidates. A risk-aware calibration-only x+1px compromise improves both cohort means and reduces the largest regression to about seven regional points. Retain individual residuals. Illustration placement, all land interiors, contrast/black levels and typography still need verification; no per-card source offsets are adopted.

pigmentTrial.gap: All six ordinary 2ED frame materials currently resolve no HSB material correction even with set-hsb-v1 enabled. Existing source-specific guards remain enforced; do not alias an obsolete fit.
pigmentTrial.review: Native HSB materially improves five palettes; white keeps source pigment. Individual reference-palette outliers remain recorded, including dark Basalt Monolith and red Chaoslace. Contrast, interior black levels, mana, typography and 25 land interiors remain open. A selected main-material proposal is not a completed set.

selection.note: Exploratory shared compromise. It improves calibration and validation means while reducing the largest white regression from roughly 23 to 7 regional index points. It is not a per-scan fit or a new blind-validation result.

dualLandGeometry.remaining: Color, typography, symbols and full-card verification remain open. Art aperture underlap is verified, but art geometry is not scored by these frame strips.

basicLandColors.scope: Shared brown-frame adjustment across fifteen original basic references; five paper adjustments. The third illustration of every basic has a darker scan palette. Retain those five measured regressions; do not fit their color individually. Colored rim accents have a separate native-verified candidate. Contrast/black levels and reuse on the ten dual composites remain open. No independent-name validation or complete-set certification.

typographyProbes.scope: Original words, independent fixed scan poses, exact full native baseline hashes. Reference dimensions are explicitly canonicalized and checked; title crops exclude mana and type crops exclude the art border. Filled gray is fixed at 130 during geometry probes. Individual fits are diagnostic and are not runtime overrides. Shared header/credit profiles, ink tone, body text, mana and whole-set validation remain open.

typographyShared.scope: One heading, type and artist geometry candidate per set, selected on calibration names only. Validation names are reused development observations. Original wording, independent scan poses, canonical 488x680 references, exact current full-card PNG hashes and zero-command replay parity are checked for all fifty-five inputs. Gray 130 is a fixed geometry-measurement control; it is not an adopted ink color. No per-printing offsets are proposed. Native profile replay after frame/color integration, actual ink tone/shadows, body text, mana and full-set verification remain open.

bodyPolicy.scope: All 302 current original faces have actual native score and isolation checks. Dragon Whelp uses its reviewed inline quotation; the remaining 301 measurements and selected PNGs are reused only after exact provided face, asset/reference, painter and pose comparisons. The common candidate parameters are unchanged and all 302 cached native scores are independently recomputed. The medium-density guard uses original compiled size and line count. These are per-set options, never printing-specific offsets. Material integration and Oracle behavior still need checking. A later original-cost review removes an erroneous X from Drain Life. Its body pixels are independently verified unchanged, but final full-face/profile capture must use the corrected mana input.

powerToughness.review: The global position/size probe improves the regional mean but regresses 26 of 92 cases, up to 11.1 points. Zoom inspection shows stroke/ink contrast differences, including 1/x examples; resolve ink/stroke/shadow matching before accepting a universal positional refit. No per-card stats overrides are proposed.

defaultEtchingAudit.clarification: Earlier evidence descriptions called these default etching outputs. They actually contain the default set-mark fallback: 13,366 covered pixels in the unchanged plane. Historical hash-equality checks remain valid; they do not establish zero coverage. No illustration-etch resolver was used. Keep historical compressed evidence unchanged.

integrationRequirements.frame: Source-bound ordinary and five basic plates, shared dual composite, independent SVG stock-mask geometry; retain existing foreign-set behavior.
integrationRequirements.color: Ordinary and all 25 land material candidates have native verification. Carry the exact semantic source values into the profile and verify them again with the integrated renderer. Preserve all dark-reference and Volcanic Island paper-color residuals; do not introduce per-printing scan/color corrections.
integrationRequirements.wording: Use current original printing inputs, including Dragon Whelp inline quotation and Drain Life 1B. Drain Life header-only replay preserves body pixels and rightmost pips; historical extra-X full-face records are superseded for header comparisons. Oracle input remains unchanged.
integrationRequirements.typography: Measure filled ink/stroke/shadow values separately from fixed-gray geometry; retain MPlantin credits unless new evidence supports another face.
integrationRequirements.body: Integrate shared count/wrap and medium-density retention with original/Oracle safety preserved; verify final full native inputs.
integrationRequirements.mana: All 277 current original costs have joint native verification. Integrate shared palette/disc/glyph/numeral geometry plus R source expansion 0.4 AND opaque-percentile paper sampling; retain X source and all numerical/measurement outliers. Recheck after complete frame/body/footer integration, Oracle mode and source-equivalence proof.
integrationRequirements.footer: Preserve printed Illus. © prefix and absence of a separate Unlimited legal line.
integrationRequirements.receipts: Scoped integration and source-equivalence evidence must preserve immutable historical receipts and avoid reopening unrelated sets.
integrationRequirements.completion: Full profile/whole-card validation and visual boundary certification are still required. No renderer profile is adopted by these study files.

basicLandAccents.scope: One source-local outline adjustment per basic color, shared across its three illustrations. Fixed projected line strips measure color; shared source rings and hue weights apply it during cached material preparation. Group means improve for all five colors, but black median error rises and four individual printings regress. Preserve every residual, including the 3.83-unit white regression. No per-card palette or per-scan offset/color fit; no independent-name validation. Land contrast/black levels and dual composite/pinline colors still need checks.

manaAudit.scope: Every mana-cost printing is measured against its fixed independently normalized original scan. Circles are about 0.5-0.75px too large in diameter, 0.4-1px too far right and around 1px too high. The black disc incorrectly shares the pale generic source palette. Glyphs are darker than the scans. These are diagnostics only: no per-card repositioning or target color adoption. Fit shared cost/glyph/numeral geometry and source pigment next, then verify full native outputs and all residuals.

manaPigmentCandidates.scope: Actual shared disc and common ink targets through the production material preparation path. Native baseline PNGs, poses, cost scores and pixel isolation are independently verified from the cache. Targets use calibration pigment quantiles rather than edge-score optimization. Validation median disc error falls 2.27 to 1.01 Oklab units; ink falls 26.88 to 3.11. The whole-cost structural index falls 70.56 to 69.62/100, confirming that color/edge objectives must remain separate. Global circle and internal glyph/numeral geometry still need their own fit. No runtime profile adopted.

manaComponents.scope: Shared source-relative mana palette, disc/pitch geometry, five colored glyph scales, numeral transforms and red-only ink expansion have actual native evidence on all 277 current original costs. Fixed frame-only scan poses are retained; no per-card placement defaults are proposed. Red expansion 0.4 requires opaque-percentile paper sampling. Existing X is retained after comparison with six cached fonts; Guardian Angel has one low-contrast X perimeter residual but remains in complete-cost replay. Physical-disc measurements succeed for all 277. Internal-ink indices sample the rightmost pip of each cost and improve 76.71 to 86.50/100, with 242 gains and 35 regressions; whole-cost structure moves 72.89 to 72.73/100, with all outliers retained. Only cost/rules pixels change, alpha is unchanged and no heading pixels change. Complete frame/body/footer integration, Oracle behavior, etching, visual normalization review and whole-card validation are still required. No runtime profile is adopted.

originalXSourceReview.residual: Guardian Angel pale disc has a search-boundary perimeter measurement. It remains in all-cost native replay; no per-card placement or scan registration is fitted.

samplerAudit.requirement: R ink expansion 0.4 and 0.6 contaminate the old fixed paper probe. The selected R 0.4 must use the existing opaque-percentile sampler. B/G expansion is not selected.

manaComponents.nativeAllCostsScope: Whole-cost indices and physical geometry cover all 277. Internal-ink indices sample the rightmost pip of every cost; they do not certify every numeral or X on multicolor/multiple-pip costs. All thirteen X originals are included in full-cost replay, with one pale-disc identity measurement flagged separately.

Four missing reviews are added; the other four retain their existing sources. The corrected Unlimited native control changes only the header, and 1B pip pixels remain byte-identical. assetsToReview.scope: Compared the pinned X with six cached font alternatives at three thresholds on thirteen actual costs. Existing X ranks first on the twelve reliable perimeter cases. Guardian Angel remains a perimeter-measurement failure; it is included in joint all-cost native replay. Numeric controls intentionally do not move X.

assetsToReview.issue: Residual line wrapping on Copy Artifact/Sea Serpent and type-specific text lengths; do not solve with per-scan offsets. Current body metrics improve across 270/302 printings but are not pixel-perfect.

dualLandPaper.scope: Five source-paper HSB candidates shared by color across all ten duals. Fixed source-alpha stripe labels, three-pixel erosion and symmetric dark-ink rejection. All actual native baseline controls reproduce; original wording and independent scan poses remain fixed. No alpha, upper-card or default etching changes; upper-card isolation covers the first 590 native rows, not a separate type-ink mask. Volcanic Island has the two regressing blue/red observations; all residuals remain in the report. This development fit is not independent-name or whole-card validation. Brown texture contrast/blackpoint and outline/pinline palettes remain open.

compromiseReview.decision: Keep the prior shared median candidate and retain Volcanic Island residuals. Penalizing worst-card regression gives up most blue improvement on the other three associated duals. No per-card palette is introduced.

dualLandPinline.scope: Actual full native cards, fixed scan poses and original text; shared geometry and source ink only. RGB-gradient magnitude cosine is local to forty fixed border strips and is not a whole-card score. Ten baseline PNGs match; upper-card rows [0,590), central rules [110,620)x[640,890), alpha and etching control checks pass. Separate complete ink and paper controls remain required. Reserved names are reused development observations. Palette/order remain unchanged.
dualLandPinline.paletteStatus: Exact native-coverage fitting and actual shared palette replay complete as a component candidate. Source edge retained; all side residuals remain. Final integrated Original/Oracle verification is still required.

paletteSelection.scope: Ten actual full native Original cards, fixed independent scan poses, fixed geometry and ordering. Forty fixed straight-side color windows are defined by native coverage controls, never reference-color thresholds. These are mean pixel Oklab distances x100, not whole-card accuracy. Exact baseline/source-palette controls, reconstruction, support isolation, alpha and default etching are checked. Two reserved names are reused development observations. All side regressions remain visible.
paletteSelection.decision: Retain the dark source edge instead of using freely brown edge ink to compensate blur. The five shared colors improve every card mean and 32/40 side windows; eight side regressions remain. The free-edge alternative has slightly better mean distance but a larger worst side regression (0.88 vs 0.38 Oklab units). No per-card palette or renderer pose is fitted.

landMaterialFinalSelection.scope: All twenty-five Original land faces at fixed independently registered scan poses. Baseline HSB rasters reproduce exactly; source curves are measured from actual PNGs using the SAME before-curve physical boundary strips, not re-detected candidate positions. Source-material controls preserve art core, white stock core, alpha and default etching. Shared Mountain strength is selected on all three development illustrations of that source material, not individual printings; no independent Mountain validation is claimed. Frame/paper medians and texture contrast are compared with actual saved native audits. These are regional Oklab distances, not whole-card scores. Final integrated profile and Original/Oracle scoring remain required.

profileAdapterPreparation.scope: All current Unlimited Original faces match their frozen controls, with current Drain Life 1B. Default etching is rendered and compared, not assumed empty. Other sets have metadata coverage only in this receipt. The complete Unlimited profile is still an integration candidate; native typography/ink, Original/Oracle, whole-card and visual normalization certification remain open.

integratedProfileStudy.inkDecision: Reject the unconstrained pixel-MSE proposal: a slightly displaced glyph can lower error by losing contrast. Use the independent softened luminance-distribution proposal for native validation; preserve filled strokes and real shadows.
